checks.name: ruff lint
checks.protects: Common bugs and risky patterns Ruff knows, such as unused imports and names used before they are set.
checks.misses: Wrong logic, and type mistakes; Pyrefly checks types.

checks.name: ruff format
checks.protects: Every file is laid out the one Ruff way, so a change shows only what it really changes.
checks.misses: Anything about what the code does; it looks at layout only.

checks.name: pyrefly
checks.protects: Values used as the wrong type, missing attributes, and calls with the wrong arguments.
checks.misses: Code with no type hints is checked less, and data from outside is never checked.

checks.name: pytest
checks.misses: Behavior no test describes, and tests that pass whatever the code does.

checks.name: uv audit
checks.protects: Installed packages with a known security hole.
checks.misses: Holes nobody has reported yet, and needs the network to run.

switchOffs.what: noqa comment switches off Ruff rules on this line
ruff: noqa or flake8: noqa switches off Ruff rules for the whole file
ruff: ignore, file-ignore, or disable switches off Ruff rules for a line, a range, or the file
type: ignore switches off the type check on this line
pyrefly: ignore switches off the type check here
fmt: off or fmt: skip switches off the formatter
pragma: no cover hides code from the test coverage count

skippedTests.what: pytest mark that skips a test or expects it to fail
pytest call that skips a running test
unittest marker that skips a test or expects it to fail

assertions.what: plain assert, as pytest uses it
pytest check that an error is raised

flakyWorkarounds.what: time.sleep or asyncio.sleep is a fixed wait
the --timeout option sets a time limit (pytest-timeout)
timeout in pytest settings sets a time limit
a Hypothesis deadline is a time limit; None takes it away
pytest.mark.flaky runs a failing test again
the flaky decorator runs a failing test again
the --reruns option runs failing tests again (pytest-rerunfailures)
reruns in pytest settings runs failing tests again
